violated_contract: Mobile app HTTP helpers must never log a response body that can carry credential material. createApiKeyServer logged the full 200 body of POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/keys, which is the newly generated app API key secret; listApiKeysServer, addMcpServer (OAuth auth_url with its state token) and getPhoneCallToken (a live call access token) echoed their bodies the same way, so a routine success path wrote secrets into device logs, the in-app talker history and anything that ships them.
canonical_prevention: On endpoints whose response schema carries a secret, token, key or OAuth URL, log the status code only and route the line through the app Logger so it is observable; a hermetic test drives each success path against a local server and asserts the secret reaches the caller but no Logger, debugPrint or print output.
